title: At the Supermarket
description: Three short recordings at the supermarket: a boy and his mum, a shop announcement and a customer at the till.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Ben and Mum
parts.intro: You will hear Ben shopping with his mum.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Right, Ben. We need milk, bread and some apples.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Can we get bananas too? I love them.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: We have bananas at home. But we need eggs.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Look! Biscuits are on sale. They're only one pound fifty.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: No, thanks. We have enough. Please get a trolley while I look for the milk.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: OK, Mum. Where's the bread?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Over there, next to the cakes.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: I found the eggs, Mum. Shall I put them carefully in the trolley, on top of the bread?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: No, put them on the top, please. The bread is heavy, and it can break them.

parts.title: Part 2 · A shop announcement
parts.intro: You will hear an announcement in a supermarket.

script.speaker: Mrs Bell
script.text: Good morning, shoppers. Today in the fruit section, oranges are half price. Fresh strawberries are two pounds a box.

script.speaker: Mrs Bell
script.text: In the bakery, you can try a free piece of chocolate cake until twelve o'clock.

script.speaker: Mrs Bell
script.text: Please remember that the shop will close early today, at six o'clock, because we are cleaning.

script.speaker: Mrs Bell
script.text: Also, a blue bicycle is outside the front door. If it's yours, please come to the help desk. Thank you for shopping with us.

script.speaker: Mrs Bell
script.text: Please ask our friendly staff if you need any help today.

parts.title: Part 3 · At the till
parts.intro: You will hear Nam paying at the till.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Hello! Did you find everything you needed?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Almost. I couldn't find any rice.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: It's in aisle five, next to the pasta. Shall I wait?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: No, thanks. I'll go quickly. Oh, and can I pay by card?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Of course. Please wait a moment. That's twelve pounds forty.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Here you are.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Would you like a bag?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Yes, please, a big one.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Thank you. Have a lovely afternoon.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: You too, sir. See you next time, and thank you for shopping with us.
